_README: Long-term (monthly) private rentals — managed manually here. These are NOT PadSplit co-living rooms and are NOT touched by the scraper. Applications go through each unit's TurboTenant link (applyUrl). Add photos to the photos[] array when ready.

units.title: Lake House — 2 Bedroom
units.description:
Bright, spacious 2 bed / 1 bath upstairs unit in a duplex-style house — furnished, freshly updated, and full of natural light! Open-concept living with hardwood floors and a full kitchen with newer stainless steel appliances. The master bedroom is huge with a walk-in closet, and the second bedroom has a closet too. The best part might be the big, brand-new deck right off the living room — lake and nature views, plus a large backyard to enjoy!

All utilities are included (electric, water, internet, and more). It comes furnished too — couch, dining table, both bed sets, and basic kitchen items to get you cooking — so just bring your clothes, bed linens, towels, and personal belongings and you're all set! Laundry is shared with the downstairs unit and is located in the garage, and your designated parking is in the driveway.

Since it's in the Norris Lake community, a 12+ month lease gets you access to the lake, pool, beach, tennis courts, and parks! Priority is given to long-term leases (12+ months). First month and security deposit, plus a background and credit check, are required to move in.

units.title: Lake House — Studio
units.description:
Newly renovated studio in a duplex-style house — comfy, furnished, private and clean! All utilities are included (electric, water, internet). Easy to move in — just bring your clothes, bed linens, towels, and personal belongings! Laundry is shared with the upstairs unit and is located in the garage (connected to the studio). The entire downstairs is yours: private entrance, private patio, and more. Your designated parking space is in the parking pad on the right side of the driveway.

Priority is given to long-term leases (12+ months). First month and security deposit, plus a background and credit check, are required to move in. And since it's in the Norris Lake community, a 12+ month lease gets you access to the lake, pool, beach, tennis courts, and nearby parks — all within the neighborhood!
